headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: STR (3)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Monaco Grand Prix from pole position, 27.9s ahead of Fernando Alonso, with Esteban Ocon completing the podium.
Guanyu Zhou made the biggest climb, from P19 to P13.
Yuki Tsunoda had a day to forget, dropping from P9 to P15.
The stewards penalised HUL (5 second time penalty), SAR (5 second time penalty), RUS (5 second time penalty) and HUL (10 second time penalty).
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 39 points over Sergio Perez.
